description: Inpaint an image using a mask and prompt. Models: 'flux_pro_1' (default, first-party Fal flux-pro fill — works) or 'flux_dev_juggernaut' (currently broken upstream, returns HTTP 500). The mask must match the image dimensions; white regions are inpainted.
default_call: Inpainting queued successfully. Job token: [redacted] Status: success Poll for results using artcraft_get_job_status with job_token '[redacted]'
default_final: Job: [redacted-token] Status: complete_success Progress: 100% Category: image_generation Result token: [redacted]
unknown_model: Error: Unknown inpaint model: no_such_model. Use flux_pro_1 (default) or flux_dev_juggernaut (currently upstream-broken).
